question: A uniform rod of length $L$ is pivoted at one end and oscillates in a vertical plane as a compound pendulum. The length of a simple pendulum with the same period is
solution:
$$T = 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{I}{mgd}} = 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{mL^2/3}{mg(L/2)}} = 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{2L}{3g}}$$

This equals a simple pendulum of length $\dfrac{2L}{3}$.
